data.title: Speed challenge: letter grades
story: Write letter_grade(score): 85 and above is "A", 70 and above "B", 55 and above "C", otherwise "D".
Hidden tests check numbers exactly at every limit. Test the limits, not just the numbers in the middle!

explanation: Check from the highest grade to the lowest with >=, so numbers exactly at a limit get the right letter. Edge cases like 85, 70 and 55 are where bugs hide most often.
hints: Start from the highest limit: if score >= 85: return "A".
If nothing matches, return "D" on the last line.
